mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SPOT_VIEW_LOG (user_idx, spot_idx, stay_seconds, viewed_at) VALUES (#{userIdx}, #{spotIdx}, #{staySeconds}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT svl.log_idx, svl.user_idx, svl.spot_idx, svl.stay_seconds, svl.viewed_at, st.name AS spot_name, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tl.tag_name ORDER BY tl.tag_name SEPARATOR ',') FROM SPOT_TAG s_tag JOIN SPOT_TAG_LIST tl ON tl.tag_idx = s_tag.tag_idx WHERE s_tag.spot_idx = svl.spot_idx ) AS tags_concat, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SPOT_VIEW_LOG svl2 WHERE svl2.user_idx = svl.user_idx AND svl2.spot_idx = svl.spot_idx ) AS visit_count FROM SPOT_VIEW_LOG svl JOIN SPOT_TRAVEL st ON st.spot_idx = svl.spot_idx WHERE svl.user_idx = #{userIdx} ORDER BY svl.viewed_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT st.spot_idx, st.name, st.region, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tl.tag_name ORDER BY tl.tag_name SEPARATOR ',') FROM SPOT_TAG s_tag JOIN SPOT_TAG_LIST tl ON tl.tag_idx = s_tag.tag_idx WHERE s_tag.spot_idx = st.spot_idx ) AS tags_concat, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SPOT_VIEW_LOG svl WHERE svl.spot_idx = st.spot_idx AND svl.user_idx = #{userIdx} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS visited_flag, /* ★ 태그 매칭 점수: 관심 태그와 일치하는 태그 수 (1순위 정렬) */
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SPOT_TAG s_tag2 JOIN SPOT_TAG_LIST tl2 ON tl2.tag_idx = s_tag2.tag_idx WHERE s_tag2.spot_idx = st.spot_idx AND FIND_IN_SET(tl2.tag_name, REPLACE(#{interestTags}, ', ', ',')) > 0 )
0
AS tag_match_score FROM SPOT_TRAVEL st WHERE /* 이전 추천 결과 spot 제외 */ NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SPOT_RECOMMEND sr WHERE sr.spot_idx = st.spot_idx AND sr.user_idx = #{userIdx} AND sr.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) ) /* ★ 현재 보고 있는 여행지 제외 */
AND st.spot_idx != #{currentSpotIdx}
ORDER BY tag_match_score DESC, /* ★ 1순위: 태그 일치 많을수록 앞으로 */ visited_flag ASC, /* 2순위: 미방문(0) 우선 */ RAND() /* 동점이면 랜덤 */ LIMIT 50
SELECT rec_idx, user_idx, spot_idx, rec_reason, rec_score FROM SPOT_RECOMMEND WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) ORDER BY rec_score DESC LIMIT 3
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SPOT_RECOMMEND (user_idx, spot_idx, rec_reason, rec_score, created_at) VALUES (#{userIdx}, #{spotIdx}, #{recReason}, #{recScore}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT sr.rec_idx, sr.user_idx, sr.spot_idx, sr.rec_reason, sr.rec_score, st.name AS spot_name, st.region, ( SELECT si.image_url FROM SPOT_IMAGE si WHERE si.spot_idx = st.spot_idx ORDER BY si.image_idx ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumb_url, COALESCE(( SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1) FROM SPOT_REVIEW r WHERE r.spot_idx = st.spot_idx ), 0.0) AS rating_avg_real, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SPOT_REVIEW r WHERE r.spot_idx = st.spot_idx) AS review_count_real, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SPOT_LIKE sl WHERE sl.spot_idx = st.spot_idx) AS like_count_real, 0 AS tag_match_count FROM SPOT_RECOMMEND sr JOIN SPOT_TRAVEL st ON st.spot_idx = sr.spot_idx WHERE sr.user_idx = #{userIdx} AND sr.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) ORDER BY sr.rec_score DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT sr.rec_idx, sr.user_idx, sr.spot_idx, sr.rec_reason, sr.rec_score, st.name AS spot_name, st.region, ( SELECT si.image_url FROM SPOT_IMAGE si WHERE si.spot_idx = st.spot_idx ORDER BY si.image_idx ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumb_url, COALESCE(( SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1) FROM SPOT_REVIEW r WHERE r.spot_idx = st.spot_idx ), 0.0) AS rating_avg_real, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SPOT_REVIEW r WHERE r.spot_idx = st.spot_idx) AS review_count_real, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SPOT_LIKE sl WHERE sl.spot_idx = st.spot_idx) AS like_count_real, /* ★ 관심 태그와 이 여행지 태그의 실제 일치 수 계산 */
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SPOT_TAG s_tag JOIN SPOT_TAG_LIST tl ON tl.tag_idx = s_tag.tag_idx WHERE s_tag.spot_idx = st.spot_idx AND FIND_IN_SET(tl.tag_name, REPLACE(#{interestTags}, ', ', ',')) > 0 )
0
AS tag_match_count FROM SPOT_RECOMMEND sr JOIN SPOT_TRAVEL st ON st.spot_idx = sr.spot_idx WHERE sr.user_idx = #{userIdx} AND sr.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) /* ★ 현재 보고 있는 여행지 제외 */
AND sr.spot_idx != #{currentSpotIdx}
ORDER BY tag_match_count DESC, /* ★ 1순위: 태그 일치 많을수록 상단 */ sr.rec_score DESC /* 2순위: Gemini 점수 순 */ LIMIT 3
